args.command: echo '=== xinput ==='; DISPLAY=:0 xinput list 2>&1 || true; echo '=== libinput log ==='; grep -Ei 'Using input driver|libinput|Logitech M545|Wireless Receiver Mouse|K270' /var/log/Xorg.0.log 2>/dev/null | tail -n 120 || true; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Verify Logitech mouse is attached to Xorg after libinput install
